name: lensnn
description: Embeds the LensNN local viewer dashboard in a VS Code editor panel.

lensnn.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to launch the LensNN backend server. Leave empty to auto-detect: a virtualenv in the workspace (.venv, venv, python/.venv, python/venv), then the interpreter selected in the Python extension, then python3/python on PATH.

lensnn.runsDirectory.description: Path to the LensNN runs directory relative to the workspace root.

lensnn.portRange.description: Local port range used to launch the LensNN backend server.
